meta.name: The Hijacking of Flight 601
meta.description: After a plane is hijacked, two flight attendants must outwit their assailants amid intense negotiations in the air and on the ground. Based on real events.

videos.title: Leave Her to Heaven
videos.overview: After a chaotic morning at home, things only get worse for Edie — until an unlikely event becomes a chance for her to redeem herself.

videos.title: Death at Her Heels
videos.overview: During a board meeting, Aerobolivar executives disagree on how to handle the crisis. Aristides makes contact with the kidnappers. Edie jumps in to help.

videos.title: Dog Day Night
videos.overview: Aristides takes matters into his own hands. Edie and Barbara plot to slow down the kidnappers — and start to suspect they're not who they claim to be.

videos.title: The Wretched of the Earth
videos.overview: The previous lives of Ulises and Toro as struggling athletes are unveiled, shedding light on the motives that led them to their present actions.

videos.title: 601: An Aerospace Odyssey
videos.overview: Chavarriaga asks Aristides to give a false testimony, but instead he rebels and forces the crew to recalibrate their plan.

videos.title: The Woman Who Knew Too Much
videos.overview: The crew gives their harrowing testimonies, but a pact forces them to withhold the truth. Will Wilches tip the balance in their favor... if he survives?
